prs.title: fix: respect disabled listChanged capabilities on v1.x
prs.author: paulelliotco
prs.reason: [llm] cluster primary: McpServer ignores explicit listChanged: false capability settings and unconditionally sends list-changed notifications for tools, resources, and prompts. (2 PRs)
prs.short_reason: [llm] cluster primary: McpServer ignores explicit listChanged: false capability settings and unconditionally sends list-changed notifications for tools, resources, and prompts. (2 PRs)
prs.cluster_pick_reason: PR #1948 is a strict superset of #1937: both make the identical mcp.ts change, both expose getCapabilities() as public, but #1948 also adds capability guards directly in sendResourceListChanged(), sendToolListChanged(), and sendPromptListChanged() in server/index.ts — defending at the transport layer so notifications are suppressed even if called from outside McpServer. PR #1937 lacks those guards entirely.

clusters.pick_reason: PR #1887's Record/dot-notation API (`isSpecType.ContentBlock(value)`, `specTypeSchemas.ContentBlock`) allows passing guards directly to array methods without a wrapper — `arr.filter(isSpecType.ContentBlock)` — which PR #1979's string-arg design (`arr.filter(v => isSpecType('ContentBlock', v))`) does not. Each entry in the Record is already a typed predicate, making TypeScript narrowing straightforward. PR #1979 is explicitly titled '[comparison]', indicating it was submitted as an alternative design proposal rather than an independent fix.
